product_policy.public_transport: Single-flow is per Transport Lane, not global. Each lane is one WBD-owned raw FakeTCP SYN lineage / 4-tuple / sequence space carrying bounded reliable Reality-like real TLS 1.3 bootstrap, an explicit no-FIN/no-new-WBD-SYN barrier, pinned wolfSSL DTLS 1.3, LINK and lane-local FEC/payload. Ordinary kernel TCP may not become the sustained WBD payload carrier.
product_policy.logical_tunnel: Logical Tunnel identity, server-assigned tunnel IP lease and Game Lane PacketID space survive lane rotation/reconnect/idle sleep. LiveID/FakeTCP/DTLS/LINK are disposable lane identities.
product_policy.multipath: ADR-0012 is authoritative. A connected Logical Tunnel may own 1..4 independent complete WBD Transport Lanes. Normal steady mode targets one lane; Game/weak-network policy may keep 2..4. Planned replacement is make-before-break A -> A+B -> B, with first-arrival delivery, duplicate suppression, no cross-lane HOL and one healthy Game lane rotated at a time.
product_policy.idle_rotation: Payload idle and transport liveness are separate clocks. Initial idle default is 15 minutes; 0 means no idle sleep. Active lanes receive independent randomized age rotation, initially 30..60 minutes as policy guidance, with staggered multi-lane replacement.
product_policy.linux_rawip: Final Windows raw-IP server direction is shared WBD TUN + Linux root routing + one WBD-owned host NAT + lease-based demux and source anti-spoof. Per-LiveID netns/veth/double NAT is historical/reference only; VRF/conntrack-zone remains rejected.
product_policy.windows: Wintun/raw L3 remains the product capture path. Underlay escape, IPv6 fail-closed connected interval, deterministic Disconnect/Exit route/DNS/IPv6/firewall cleanup and Npcap release constraints remain mandatory. Windows lane planning may create 1..4 independent per-lane same-flow children without changing the mature TCP-like core.
product_policy.observability: Keep non-secret correlation IDs, first-boundary markers and counters; do not log usernames/passwords/tickets/resume secrets/identity secrets and do not enable per-packet INFO spam.
product_policy.withdrawn_policy: ADR-0013 global-one-public-transport, Game Lane removal, second-lane rejection and break-before-make are withdrawn and must not be reintroduced by code, tests, docs or PR metadata.
